read.description: Read throughput limit, e.g. "10MiB/s" or "1000iops". Empty means unlimited.

write.description: Write throughput limit, e.g. "5MiB/s" or "500iops". Empty means unlimited.

size.description: Disk quota for the whole container root filesystem, e.g. "20GiB". Requires a quota-capable storage pool (btrfs, zfs or lvm); rejected on a dir pool. Empty means unlimited.

tmpfs_size.description: Opt-in RAM-backed /tmp of this size, e.g. "2GiB". Unset: /tmp stays on disk (use size to bound total disk use).
